summary: A Vercel-style hero on a 1482x1080 canvas. A slim nav bar runs along the top (black Vercel triangle at x 127, links Products ▾ / Resources ▾ / Enterprise / Pricing, then three pill buttons on the right: Get a Demo, Log In and a filled Sign Up ending at x 1334). The left column, aligned at x≈127, holds a two-line tight-tracked headline, "Build and run / agents on Vercel" (~56px, y 298–402), a two-line grey subhead and two pill CTAs: a filled "Create an agent" and an outlined "Talk to an expert". The right half shows an isometric 3D cube drawn as a hexagon (box ≈803,347,352,320). It has three rounded rhombus faces, top, lower-left and right, separated by gaps. Six thick black chevron frame segments sit around them, and a faint hexagonal halo and a soft drop shadow sit underneath. A small white Vercel triangle sits on the top face. Above the cube are two chat bubbles joined to it by hairline connectors: a user bubble "@data-agent How did revenue trend last quarter by region?" at the top right, and an agent reply bubble with a small robot avatar circle to its left. Along the bottom, a four-column stat row (4T+, 3×, 1M+, < 5 min; ~56px light-weight numerals at y≈858, two-line grey captions at y≈930) starts at x 126/434/741/1048. Motion: a cursor moves over the cube. The face under the cursor lightens to a soft grey gradient, and an annotation fades in (~200 ms) with a short hairline leader, a bold title and a 3-line grey caption: Connect (bottom-left, ~0.2–1.0s), Sandbox (right, ~1.0–1.7s), eve (top-left, ~1.8–2.4s), Drives (left, ~2.5–3.2s). From ~3.3s nothing is annotated. At ~4.1s the page hard-cuts from light (#f7f7f7 bg, near-black type) to dark (#000 bg, white type, buttons inverted). The cube becomes outline-only: black faces with thin grey stroked edges and outlined frame segments. In dark mode, hovering the lower-left face lights it and brings back Connect (~5.1–5.9s), which then fades as the cursor leaves. The layout never moves; only the hover highlights, annotations, cursor and theme change.

The theme change is an instant cut at about 4.1s (light at 4.0s, fully dark at 4.15s), not a slow fade
A solid black equilateral triangle logo sits at top-left around x 127, y 20
Nav reads 'Products', 'Resources' (each with a small down chevron), 'Enterprise', 'Pricing' left-to-right from x≈172
'Sign Up' is a black filled rounded button with white text at right end (x≈1270–1334) while 'Get a Demo' and 'Log In' are white with thin borders
In dark mode 'Sign Up' is a white/light filled button with black text
Headline reads exactly 'Build and run' / 'agents on Vercel' on two lines
Headline left edge at x≈127, cap tops y≈298 and baseline of line 2 near y≈398, roughly 56px type with tight negative tracking
Subhead reads 'Build agents, run them on agentic infrastructure, / and put them to work across your business.' in mid-grey ~16px
'Create an agent' is a fully rounded black pill (~133x34 at x 127, y 500) with white text
'Talk to an expert' is a white pill with a faint grey border, dark text, starting x≈274
In dark mode 'Create an agent' becomes a light grey pill with black text and 'Talk to an expert' a black pill with grey border and white text
Top-right bubble reads '@data-agent How did revenue trend last quarter by region?' with '@data-agent' in bold
User bubble is white with a thin light border, ~12px radius and a small tail at its bottom-right corner
Second bubble reads 'EMEA up 18%, North America down 4%.' / 'I posted the chart in channel #revenue.'
A small circular avatar (~28px) with a robot-head icon sits left of the agent bubble at about x 758, y 270
Thin grey vertical hairlines drop from the bubbles toward the cube at x≈888 and x≈1085
The cube silhouette is a pointy-sided hexagon spanning about x 803–1155, y 347–667, centred right of the page middle
Cube is built from 3 separate rounded rhombus faces (top, lower-left, right) with visible gaps between them
In light mode six thick solid-black chevron frame segments wrap around the faces (top bar, bottom bar, two left and two right angled bars)
Light-mode faces are glossy black with subtle dark-grey gradients (not flat), and a soft grey drop shadow spreads below the cube
In dark mode the cube is outline-only: black faces with thin grey stroked edges, and frame segments drawn as grey outlines rather than solid fills
A small white triangle (~19px) sits near the lower-left corner of the top face at x≈851, y≈466
A faint hexagonal halo outline surrounds the cube a few px outside its silhouette

Connect annotation's text starts at x≈719, y≈663, with a short horizontal hairline leader from x≈843 to ≈893 at y≈668 touching the cube's lower-left corner
To the right of the cube an annotation reads 'Sandbox' / 'Ran the regional breakdown in an isolated microVM' with a hairline leader on its left at y≈507
Top-left annotation reads 'eve' / 'Defines data-agent with a run_sql tool and a revenue skill', leader hairline at y≈344 from x≈843 to ≈893
Left-side annotation reads 'Drives' / 'Saved the Q3 export and chart for the next question' with leader at y≈507 ending at the cube's left point
Between 2.05s and 2.55s the eve annotation disappears and the Drives annotation fades in (still pale grey at 2.55s) as the cursor moves to the cube's left point
Connect annotation is visible at 1.0s and gone by 2.05s while the Sandbox note shows in between (~1.5s), one annotation at a time
In dark mode Connect is visible in white/grey at 5.65s and fades out by 6.15s as the cursor leaves the cube's bottom edge
Annotations fade in/out over roughly 0.2s (intermediate pale grey states visible) rather than popping
